title: Home guide: making sounds you can see
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: States of matter (Marvellous Medicine and How Far Can Sound Travel?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 13 (Home practical guide and safety card: rice drum and ruler (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how vibrations make sound.
equipment: A ruler and a table edge
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Stretch cling film tightly over the bowl.
Put a few grains of rice on top.
Tap the side of the bowl gently, then a little harder. Watch the rice.
Hold a ruler over the table edge and twang it. Make the overhang shorter: what happens to the sound?
